app_long_line_2000pt.note: hillclimb.md W-L2: a frame (tick + view) of a 2000-point stage line described every view, a ball rolling on it. Mostly reading the 4000-number line back from Lua each view; cache it by table if it grows. nixos worker, release.

cart_on_long_line_step.note: hillclimb.md W-L2: one 120 Hz step of a two-wheeled sprung, motor-driven cart on a 2000-point, 200 000-unit line. nixos worker, release.

app_chat_300_edit_grouped.note: ui-reuse.md step 2: 300 chat rows each in a ui.group, one message edited, then the view (Lua + walk; layout not included). Recorded under load ~5, so likely high. What is left is cloning 300 kept subtrees and re-registering their handlers.

app_chat_300_edit_plain.note: reference, not a target: the same list without groups, every row described every view.

app_pickup_5000_chunked.note: a coin picked up, 50 groups of 100: the update and the view after it. Target: under 2.5 ms.

app_pickup_5000_one_group.note: reference, not a target: one group of 5000 re-describes whole. The guide says chunk instead.

app_walk_20000_camera.note: walking past 20000 coins in 200 groups through a 1280x720 camera following the hero (~2300 on screen). Target: under 2 ms, met narrowly (1.8–2.0 ms on a quiet machine); the check of every entity against the view is the next lever (a spatial grid).

app_walk_5000_grouped.note: a frame of walking past 5000 coins in groups: tick and view. Target: a world's share of a 16.6 ms frame stays under 2 ms.

app_walk_5000_plain.note: reference, not a target: the same 5000 coins without groups, described every view.

frame_encode_20000.note: 20000 sprite instances encoded into a vello scene: the CPU half of painting.

frame_encode_5000.note: 5000 sprite instances encoded into a vello scene.

signal_update_5000.note: an update of a 5000-item signal: nearly all of it the freeze checking every entry.

text_60_paragraphs_cold.note: reference: the same with nothing cached, i.e. the first frame or a screen full of new text.

text_60_paragraphs_warm.note: 60 wrapped ~400-char paragraphs measured and painted, all cached; what is left is encoding glyphs into the scene. 14.2 ms with the cache off.

text_page_edit_frame.note: same page, one cell's text changes each frame: a miss costs nothing visible. 191 ms with the cache off.

text_page_warm_frame.note: ui-reuse.md §2a: 100 wrapping chat messages + a 50x8 table, unscrolled and unculled, a frame with nothing changed. 186 ms with the shaping cache off.

workspace_list_40_idle_frame.note: ui-reuse.md U1: 40 cards, same setup. 13.8 ms before the text shaping cache, 2.4 after; ~0.05 ms a card.

workspace_list_8_idle_frame.note: ui-reuse.md U1: 8 workspace cards, a frame with nothing changing (view, layout, hit, paint) in Headless, one pinned core, quiet machine. 2.7 ms before the text shaping cache (step 1a), 0.52 after.

world_frame_20000.note: the same for 20000, every entity drawn. Was refused by the 4096-item cap.

world_frame_20000_camera.note: the same 20000 through a 1280x720 camera: ~6% drawn. Most of it is checking every entity against the view; a spatial grid would cut that.

world_frame_5000.note: building the frame of a 5000-entity world, every entity drawn (the box is the whole map). Includes each entity's view check.

world_inspect_5000.note: the dump's world inspection of 5000 entities.

world_reconcile_fresh_5000.note: diffing 5000 specs described afresh (built outside the timing).

world_reconcile_kept_5000.note: 5000 entities in a kept group described again: what groups save.

world_steps_5000.note: a 60 fps frame of steps (two) for 5000 things, 200 balls bouncing among 800 rocks.
